name: Finland

authorities.competent_authority: Fimea (Finnish Medicines Agency): national contact point, supervises clinical trials, contributes to the assessment and issues the national authorisation decision in CTIS.
authorities.ethics: Tukija (National Committee on Medical Research Ethics) leads the Finnish Part II assessment, prepares the Part II assessment report and performs the ethical review. No separate ethics application outside CTIS; requests for information, responses and the decision are handled in CTIS.
authorities.fee: One joint fee through Fimea, invoiced to the sponsor after Part I has been accepted for processing. Invoicing details go in the CTIS Proof of payment section (FI-FEE), not Part II.
authorities.accelerated_procedure: Since 11 February 2026, Finland-only applications of any phase and sponsor type may receive a decision within 30 calendar days from CTIS submission when no corrections or requests for information are needed. A processing pathway, not a reduced dossier.
authorities.file_format: PDF or PDF/A; no signatures on dossier documents at CTIS submission (Tukija).

answer_languages_note: Finland is a two-language country. Each language is a package: fi (Finnish, reference package, templates supplied) and sv (Swedish, participant templates missing). Part II forms are answered in the package language: K1 and the procedure only in Finnish or Swedish; the other forms may also be answered in English (DECISIONS.md D1). Per document, languages_required says which languages are needed and when.

language_rules.rule: The general application dossier may be in Finnish, Swedish or English (Clinical Trials Act 983/2021). Recruitment advertising, the recruitment and informed-consent procedure and Annex I section L materials (information sheets and consent forms) must be in Finnish and/or Swedish (Tukija T/448/2026).
language_rules.when_finnish: Default and reference language: the Finnish documents are drafted from the supplied Finnish templates and submitted in CTIS. The trial code and a concise, clear Finnish trial title identify the document.
language_rules.when_swedish: Swedish participant documents are needed whenever Swedish-speaking participants or representatives are enrolled (study fact population.swedish_speakers), because each participant receives information in a language they understand. A Swedish version does not need to be submitted in CTIS after the Finnish version has been approved. The guides give no rule by site region.
language_rules.other_languages: Participants who speak neither Finnish nor Swedish receive all patient-facing documents in a language they understand; unless the research team speaks it, an interpreter familiar with clinical trials, the participant's culture and the Finnish operating environment is needed throughout the research, not only at the signature visit (study fact population.non_finnish_swedish_speakers).
language_rules.patient_forms: Questionnaires, diaries and other participant forms: Part I in Finnish, Swedish or English, generally following the protocol language; no separate Part II translations required (Tukija).
language_rules.form_answers: Shared EU forms (content/eu/templates/part-ii) answered in the package language (fi or sv). English accepted for M1, M2, N1, O, P, R1 and S1; not for K1 and the consent procedure.

study_facts_country_specific.population.swedish_speakers: Will Swedish-speaking participants or representatives be enrolled at Finnish sites (Swedish documents needed)?
study_facts_country_specific.population.non_finnish_swedish_speakers: Will people who speak neither Finnish nor Swedish be enrolled (translated documents and interpreter throughout)?
study_facts_country_specific.population.minors_independent_consent_15: Are adolescents aged 15-17 enrolled in a trial within Article 32(1)(g)(i), so that a capable adolescent may consent independently with the guardian informed?
study_facts_country_specific.radiation.additional_exposure: Does the trial add ionising-radiation exposure compared with usual care (dose, risk, frequency and total dose must be explained)?
study_facts_country_specific.trial.cluster: Is it a cluster trial (Article 30 simplified consent is not available in Finland)?
study_facts_country_specific.trial.finland_only: Is Finland the only Member State concerned (accelerated 30-day procedure possible)?
study_facts_country_specific.contract.other_sponsor_site_agreements: Are there other relevant agreements between the sponsor and a Finnish site?
study_facts_country_specific.data.transfer_outside_eea: Are data transferred outside the EU/EEA (known countries and safeguards must be stated)?

documents.name_en: Recruitment arrangements (EU Recruitment and Informed Consent Procedure form)
documents.language_rule: Finnish and/or Swedish (the Finland-specific parts of the EU form must be completed in Finnish and/or Swedish). English is not accepted.

languages_required.fi: Default answer language of the Finnish package.
languages_required.sv: Answer language only when the Swedish package is the one submitted, or when both language versions are filed (DECISIONS.md D2). Not needed merely because Swedish-speaking participants are enrolled.

template.basis: EU Recruitment and Informed Consent Procedure template, version 2.0 (published 1 June 2026; applies to new Part II submissions from 1 September 2026); requested by Tukija

documents.content: Mandatory content: the inclusion procedure and a clearly identified first act of recruitment. A separate document is required under Annex I section K when the information is not already in the protocol. Tukija requests the EU Recruitment and Informed Consent Procedure template; the Finland-specific parts are completed in Finnish and/or Swedish. Submitted under Recruitment arrangements, unsigned, PDF or PDF/A.

national_fields.v105: Required in Finland: in Finnish and/or Swedish, state that every advertisement, invitation and other recruitment communication is submitted under Recruitment materials in Finnish and/or Swedish before use, that audio and video are submitted as a transcript (audio) or a transcript or storyboard (video), not as media files, and how responses are handled and people found unsuitable are informed (Tukija T/448/2026).
national_fields.v108: Required in Finland: in Finnish and/or Swedish, state that a qualified member of the investigating team gives the prior information, answers questions, allows enough decision time and verifies understanding; that the participant or legal representative and the person receiving consent sign and date the approved Finnish/Swedish form when consent is obtained (blank and unsigned in CTIS); that the original stays in the investigator's archive and a paper or electronic copy is given; that participants who speak neither Finnish nor Swedish receive all patient-facing documents in a language they understand, with an interpreter familiar with clinical trials, the participant's culture and the Finnish operating environment throughout the research unless the team speaks the language; and, for a cluster trial, that the Article 30 simplified consent route is not used in Finland.
national_fields.v110: Required in Finland when adults with reduced capacity are included: in Finnish and/or Swedish, describe the documented capacity assessment (diagnosis, disability or residence in care does not by itself prove incapacity); who consents under section 13 of the Clinical Trials Act 983/2021 (the legal representative; if there is none, a close family member or another person close to the participant) and how the site identifies that person and documents the relationship; the adapted participant information and any assent or acknowledgement; how verbal, behavioural or supported-communication dissent is recognised and respected; reassessment of capacity and the participant's own consent when capacity returns; and how a decision made before capacity was lost is evaluated under Article 31.
national_fields.v114: Required in Finland when minors are included: in Finnish and/or Swedish, describe the justified developmental groups and their documents (Tukija sets no fixed bands); guardian or other legal representative consent plus the written consent of a minor who can form an opinion and evaluate the information (section 14, Act 983/2021); the age-15 pathway, where an adolescent aged 15 to 17 consents independently only in an Article 32(1)(g)(i) direct-benefit trial and when able to understand its significance, with the guardian informed, including how understanding is assessed and how the guardian is notified; respect for a capable minor's refusal; and re-consent at 18 and on entering the age-15 pathway, as defined in the protocol.
national_fields.v117: Required in Finland when an impartial witness may be used: in Finnish and/or Swedish, state that the witness route applies only when the consenting participant or legal representative cannot write (not for another language, limited literacy or interpreter use alone); who checks the witness's independence and eligibility and what happens when no suitable witness is available; how the interpreter and witness roles are separated or, if one person does both, why; and that the witness and the person who conducted the discussion sign and date the consent record.
national_fields.v121: Required in Finland when emergency enrolment is used: in Finnish and/or Swedish, describe how the sudden serious condition, the therapeutic window, why the participant and the representative could not be informed in time, the direct-benefit basis, the check for a previously expressed objection and the time of the first intervention are recorded in the source; later consent without undue delay (representative for minors and adults with reduced capacity; otherwise participant or representative, whichever can decide sooner, and the participant's own consent once capable); the right to object to use of data already obtained; and staff instructions that separate trial documentation from urgent clinical care. No form may state retrospectively that consent was given before enrolment.

documents.drafting_notes_fi: CTIS Part II, osio K (Recruitment arrangements). Pakollinen. EU:n Recruitment and Informed Consent Procedure -malli, versio 2.0 (uusiin Part II -hakemuksiin 1.9.2026 alkaen; Tukija pyytää tätä mallia). Suomea koskevat kohdat täytetään suomeksi ja/tai ruotsiksi; englanti ei kelpaa. Ei allekirjoitusta jätettäessä; PDF tai PDF/A. Kuvaa sisäänottomenettely ja yksilöi selvästi ensimmäinen rekrytointitoimi (v101). Täytä kunkin suunnitelmassa olevan polun osio (heikentynyt itsemääräämiskyky, alaikäiset, puolueeton todistaja, hätätilanne); muut merkitään 'Ei' ja N/A. Kansalliset lisäykset kenttiin v105, v108, v110, v114, v117 ja v121 (national_fields; lääketutkimuslaki 983/2021, 13 ja 14 §). Sama täytetty lomake ladataan myös kohtaan Subject information and informed consent procedure (FI-L1-PROCEDURE).
documents.drafting_notes_sv: CTIS del II, avsnitt K (Recruitment arrangements). Obligatoriskt. EU-mallen Recruitment and Informed Consent Procedure, version 2.0 (för nya del II-ansökningar från 1.9.2026; Tukija begär denna mall). De Finlandsspecifika delarna fylls i på finska och/eller svenska; engelska godtas inte. Ingen underskrift vid inlämning; PDF eller PDF/A. Beskriv inklusionsförfarandet och ange tydligt den första rekryteringsåtgärden (v101). Fyll i avsnittet för varje väg i planen (nedsatt självbestämmanderätt, minderåriga, opartiskt vittne, nödsituation); övriga markeras 'Nej' och N/A. Nationella tillägg i fälten v105, v108, v110, v114, v117 och v121 (national_fields; lagen om kliniska läkemedelsprövningar 983/2021, 13 och 14 §). Samma ifyllda formulär laddas också upp under Subject information and informed consent procedure (FI-L1-PROCEDURE).

documents.trigger_text: Any advertisement, invitation or other communication used to recruit participants.
documents.language_rule: Finnish and/or Swedish (Clinical Trials Act 983/2021; Tukija T/448/2026). English is not accepted. Participants who speak neither language receive every patient-facing document in a language they understand, with an interpreter throughout the trial unless the team speaks that language.

languages_required.fi: Finnish package (default, reference): Finnish and/or Swedish is mandatory for this document; the Finnish version is the one TrialAgents drafts from the supplied Finnish templates and submits in CTIS.
languages_required.sv: Required for use whenever Swedish-speaking participants or representatives are enrolled (population.swedish_speakers): each person receives the documents in a language they understand. It may be submitted with the Finnish version, but Tukija does not require it to be added to CTIS after the Finnish version is approved. No Swedish participant templates were supplied: adapt from the approved Finnish document (based_on) (DECISIONS.md D2, D3).

documents.content: Every advertisement, invitation and communication used to recruit, plus the procedure for handling responses and informing people found unsuitable (described in K1). Do not upload audio or video files: submit a transcript for audio and a transcript or storyboard for video. Upload under Recruitment materials. Must not minimise risk or present payment as the main reason to join.
documents.drafting_notes_fi: CTIS Part II, osio K (Recruitment materials). Ehdollinen: jokainen rekrytointi-ilmoitus, kutsu ja muu viestintä. Suomeksi ja/tai ruotsiksi, ei allekirjoitusta. Ääni- tai videotiedostoja ei ladata: äänestä litterointi, videosta litterointi tai kuvakäsikirjoitus. Yhteydenottojen käsittely ja soveltumattomiksi todettujen informointi kuvataan K1-lomakkeessa. Ei riskejä vähätteleviä ilmauksia eikä palkkiota pääsyynä osallistua.
documents.drafting_notes_sv: CTIS del II, avsnitt K (Recruitment materials). Villkorat: varje rekryteringsannons, inbjudan och annan kommunikation. På finska och/eller svenska, ingen underskrift. Ladda inte upp ljud- eller videofiler: för ljud en transkription, för video en transkription eller ett storyboard. Hanteringen av svar och information till personer som inte är lämpliga beskrivs i K1-formuläret. Inga formuleringar som tonar ned risker och ingen ersättning som huvudskäl att delta.

documents.name_en: Participant Information Sheet and Informed Consent Form
documents.language_rule: Finnish and/or Swedish (Clinical Trials Act 983/2021; Tukija T/448/2026). English is not accepted. Participants who speak neither language receive every patient-facing document in a language they understand, with an interpreter throughout the trial unless the team speaks that language.

languages_required.fi: Finnish package (default, reference): Finnish and/or Swedish is mandatory for this document; the Finnish version is the one TrialAgents drafts from the supplied Finnish templates and submits in CTIS.
languages_required.sv: Required for use whenever Swedish-speaking participants or representatives are enrolled (population.swedish_speakers): each person receives the documents in a language they understand. It may be submitted with the Finnish version, but Tukija does not require it to be added to CTIS after the Finnish version is approved. No Swedish participant templates were supplied: adapt from the approved Finnish document (based_on) (DECISIONS.md D2, D3).

documents.template_note: Participant templates are bound per population: see population_sets and participant_templates (Finnish set supplied; Swedish set missing).
documents.content: Blank information sheet and consent form that potential participants or their legal representatives receive before deciding, on Tukija's Finland-specific template (T/447/2026, 25 June 2026) adapted to the protocol and population. Signed and dated at consent by the participant or legal representative and by the person receiving consent; original archived by the investigator, copy to the participant.
documents.drafting_notes_fi: CTIS Part II, osio L. Pakollinen, yksi asiakirjakokonaisuus kutakin populaatiota kohden. Pohjana Tukijan T/447/2026-malli (25.6.2026). Suomeksi ja/tai ruotsiksi; tutkimuksen koodi ja lyhyt, selkeä suomenkielinen nimi yksilöivät asiakirjan. Tyhjä ja allekirjoittamaton CTIS-versio; allekirjoitus- ja päiväyskentät jätetään tyhjiksi suostumustilannetta varten. Noin 5–8 sivua, yleensä enintään 10. Säilytä Tukijan lääkevahinkovakuutusta ja potilasvakuutusta koskeva teksti, ellei todellinen vakuutusturva poikkea. Ruotsinkielistä versiota ei tarvitse lisätä CTIS:ään suomenkielisen version hyväksymisen jälkeen.
documents.drafting_notes_sv: CTIS del II, avsnitt L. Obligatoriskt, en dokumentuppsättning per population. Grund: Tukijas mall T/447/2026 (25.6.2026). På finska och/eller svenska; prövningens kod och en kort, tydlig titel identifierar dokumentet. Tom och osignerad CTIS-version; underskrifts- och datumfält lämnas tomma för samtyckestillfället. Cirka 5–8 sidor, normalt högst 10. Behåll Tukijas text om läkemedelsskadeförsäkringen och patientförsäkringen om inte det faktiska försäkringsskyddet avviker. Ingen svensk mall har levererats: översätt från det godkända finska dokumentet. En svensk version behöver inte läggas till i CTIS efter att den finska versionen har godkänts.

documents.note: Drafted once as FI-K1 (sections 2 to 6 of the EU form carry this content); the same final file is uploaded in the L placeholder. DECISIONS.md D4.

documents.drafting_notes_fi: CTIS Part II, osio L (Subject information and informed consent procedure). Pakollinen. Sama täytetty EU-lomake (versio 2.0) kuin FI-K1; ei laadita erikseen. Suomeksi ja/tai ruotsiksi, ei allekirjoitusta. Tarkista, että tiedottaminen, ennakkohaastattelun tekijä, ymmärtämisen varmistaminen, harkinta-aika, suostumuksen dokumentointi ja kaikki polut (alaikäiset, heikentynyt itsemääräämiskyky, puolueeton todistaja, hätätilanne) on kuvattu.
documents.drafting_notes_sv: CTIS del II, avsnitt L (Subject information and informed consent procedure). Obligatoriskt. Samma ifyllda EU-formulär (version 2.0) som FI-K1; upprättas inte separat. På finska och/eller svenska, ingen underskrift. Kontrollera att information, vem som håller förhandssamtalet, kontroll av förståelse, betänketid, dokumentation av samtycket och alla vägar (minderåriga, nedsatt självbestämmanderätt, opartiskt vittne, nödsituation) är beskrivna.

documents.content: Separate, understandable documents for each population that follows a different information or signature pathway. Tukija expects separate documents for representatives and for distinct groups recruited because of age or cognitive ability. Blank at submission.
documents.drafting_notes_fi: CTIS Part II, osio L. Ehdollinen: erillinen, ymmärrettävä asiakirja jokaiselle populaatiolle, jolla on eri tiedottamis- tai allekirjoituspolku (huoltajat, lapset kehitystason mukaan, nuoret, heikentyneen itsemääräämiskyvyn aikuiset ja edustajat, hätätilanteessa mukaan otetut, puolueeton todistaja, raskaana oleva kumppani, tuleva käyttö). Pelkkä allekirjoitusotsikon vaihtaminen ei riitä. Suomeksi ja/tai ruotsiksi, tyhjänä ja allekirjoittamattomana.
documents.drafting_notes_sv: CTIS del II, avsnitt L. Villkorat: ett separat, begripligt dokument för varje population med en annan informations- eller underskriftsväg (vårdnadshavare, barn efter utvecklingsnivå, unga, vuxna med nedsatt självbestämmanderätt och deras företrädare, personer som inkluderats i en nödsituation, opartiskt vittne, gravid partner, framtida användning). Det räcker inte att byta rubrik på underskriften. På finska och/eller svenska, tomt och osignerat. Ingen svensk mall har levererats.

documents.content: All information required by GDPR Articles 12 to 14: controller or joint controllers, contacts, purposes, legal bases cited by article, paragraph and point (Tukija's template names Articles 6(1)(c), 6(1)(e) and 9(2)(i) as possible Finnish bases; the controller selects), balancing test if legitimate interest is used, data categories, sources (patient records, registries), direct remote access, recipients, retention, rights, the Data Protection Ombudsman complaint route, transfers outside the EU/EEA and safeguards, accurate pseudonymisation wording, 'ethnic background' instead of 'race'.
documents.drafting_notes_fi: CTIS Part II, osio L. Pakollinen sisältö: kaikki EU:n tietosuoja-asetuksen 12–14 artiklan edellyttämät tiedot. Oletuksena tutkimustiedotteen tietosuojaosio; erillinen tietosuojaseloste tai liite vain, jos niin päätetään. Sama kielisääntö kuin suostumusasiakirjoissa (suomi ja/tai ruotsi), ei allekirjoitusta. Käsittelyperusteet artiklan, kohdan ja alakohdan tarkkuudella; älä kutsu pseudonymisoituja tietoja anonyymeiksi; käytä sanaa etninen tausta, ei rotu; mainitse tietosuojavaltuutetun valitusreitti.
documents.drafting_notes_sv: CTIS del II, avsnitt L. Obligatoriskt innehåll: all information som krävs enligt artiklarna 12–14 i dataskyddsförordningen. Som standard i forskningsinformationens dataskyddsavsnitt; ett separat dataskyddsmeddelande eller en bilaga endast om så beslutas. Samma språkregel som för samtyckesdokumenten (finska och/eller svenska), ingen underskrift. Rättslig grund anges med artikel, punkt och led; kalla inte pseudonymiserade uppgifter anonyma; skriv etnisk bakgrund, inte ras; ange klagomålsvägen till dataombudsmannen.

template.basis: EU Compensation for Trial Participants template, requested by Tukija

documents.content: Expenses, loss of earnings, inconvenience payments and any costs that could fall to the participant. Protocol-required medicines, administration devices and procedures are normally free; explain and justify any exception. Finnish law permits reasonable inconvenience compensation for participants outside the protected categories; payment reflects time and burden, not risk acceptance; withdrawal must not be financially punitive. Minors receive no financial benefits or incentives; only direct costs and loss of earnings may be reimbursed (Finnish minors template).
documents.drafting_notes_fi: CTIS Part II, osio P. Pakollinen ilmoitus, maksutiedot ehdollisesti. EU:n Compensation for Trial Participants -malli. Englanti hyväksytään lomakkeessa; tutkittaville annettavat selitykset tutkittavan asiakirjan kielellä. Ei allekirjoitusta. Kerro kulukorvaukset, ansionmenetys, haittakorvaus ja tutkittavalle mahdollisesti jäävät kulut; tutkimussuunnitelman edellyttämät lääkkeet, antovälineet ja toimenpiteet ovat yleensä maksuttomia, ja poikkeus perustellaan. Haittakorvaus kohtuullinen, ei riskin hyväksymisestä; keskeyttäminen ei saa johtaa taloudelliseen rangaistukseen. Summien ja ehtojen on vastattava tutkimustiedotteita.
documents.drafting_notes_sv: CTIS del II, avsnitt P. Obligatorisk redogörelse, betalningsuppgifter villkorat. EU-mallen Compensation for Trial Participants. Engelska godtas i formuläret; förklaringar till deltagarna på deltagardokumentets språk. Ingen underskrift. Ange kostnadsersättningar, inkomstbortfall, ersättning för olägenhet och kostnader som kan falla på deltagaren; läkemedel, administreringsutrustning och åtgärder som prövningsplanen kräver är normalt avgiftsfria, och undantag motiveras. Ersättningen för olägenhet ska vara skälig, inte för att acceptera risk; avbrott får inte leda till ekonomisk bestraffning. Belopp och villkor ska stämma överens med forskningsinformationen.

Erillistä allekirjoitusta ei tarvita, koska CTIS-jättäminen katsotaan toimeksiantajan vahvistukseksi. Kansallista lisälausetta ei vaadita (r1_the_sponsor_declares: ei sovellu). Toimeksiantajan nimi- ja roolikentät vain lähteistä; muuten puuttuva tieto.
documents.drafting_notes_sv: CTIS formuläravsnitt (Form section). Obligatoriskt: EU-försäkran om att uppgifter samlas in och behandlas i enlighet med unionens dataskyddslagstiftning. Engelska godtas. Sponsorns namn- och rollfält endast från källorna; annars saknad uppgift.

documents.content: Sample collection, archive use, analysis, storage, access, coding and future use, consistent with the protocol and participant documents. If optional future use of samples or related data outside the protocol is requested, the future-use section is completed and a separate future-use information sheet and consent form on Tukija's template is submitted (population set secondary_use).

national_fields.f03: Finland, only when samples or related data will be used outside the protocol: state that future use is offered through a separate, optional Finnish and/or Swedish information sheet and consent form based on Tukija's future-use template (T/171/2025), independent of trial participation, and that refusal does not affect participation or treatment. Otherwise answer not applicable.

documents.drafting_notes_fi: CTIS Part II, osio S. Pakollinen jokaisessa hakemuksessa, myös jos näytteitä ei kerätä: valitse silloin Ei ja merkitse yksityiskohtaiset kohdat ohjeen mukaisesti ei sovellu. Englanti hyväksytään; ei allekirjoitusta. Tietojen on vastattava tutkimussuunnitelmaa, näytesuunnitelmaa ja tutkimustiedotteita. Jos näytteitä tai niihin liittyviä tietoja käytetään tutkimussuunnitelman ulkopuolella, täytä tulevan käytön osio ja laadi erillinen, vapaaehtoinen tiedote ja suostumus Tukijan mallin (T/171/2025) pohjalta (f03, national_fields).
documents.drafting_notes_sv: CTIS del II, avsnitt S. Obligatoriskt i varje ansökan, även om inga prover samlas in: välj då Nej och markera de detaljerade avsnitten som ej tillämpliga enligt anvisningen. Engelska godtas; ingen underskrift. Uppgifterna ska stämma överens med prövningsplanen, provplanen och forskningsinformationen. Om prover eller tillhörande uppgifter används utanför prövningsplanen, fyll i avsnittet om framtida användning och upprätta en separat, frivillig information och samtycke utifrån Tukijas mall (T/171/2025) (f03, national_fields).

documents.name_en: Other patient-facing forms (questionnaires, diaries and similar)
documents.trigger_text: Questionnaires, diaries and other forms intended for participants.
documents.language_rule: Finnish, Swedish or English, generally following the protocol language (Tukija). Tukija does not require separate translations in Part II for patient-facing documents other than recruitment materials and participant information sheets.

languages_required.fi: Accepted; use when the protocol language is Finnish.
languages_required.sv: Accepted; use when the protocol language is Swedish.
languages_required.en: Accepted; normally the protocol language for multinational trials.

documents.content: Forms must be understandable and consistent with the protocol. Finland-specific placement: Tukija asks for these forms in Part I in Finnish, Swedish or English; check the current CTIS upload structure before filing, because the European Commission Q&A generally places participant-form translations in Part II.
documents.note: Conflict: Tukija T/448/2026 (7 May 2026, national, newer) places them in Part I; the EC Q&A (March 2026) generally places translations in Part II. Tukija is followed; DECISIONS.md D7.
documents.drafting_notes_fi: Tukijan ohjeen mukaan kyselylomakkeet, päiväkirjat ja muut tutkittaville tarkoitetut lomakkeet toimitetaan Part I:ssä suomeksi, ruotsiksi tai englanniksi, yleensä tutkimussuunnitelman kielellä; erillisiä käännöksiä ei vaadita Part II:ssa. Tarkista CTIS:n ajantasainen latausrakenne ennen jättämistä (EU-komission Q&A sijoittaa käännökset yleensä Part II:een). Lomakkeiden on oltava ymmärrettäviä ja vastattava tutkimussuunnitelmaa.
documents.drafting_notes_sv: Enligt Tukija lämnas frågeformulär, dagböcker och andra formulär för deltagare in i del I på finska, svenska eller engelska, i regel på prövningsplanens språk; separata översättningar krävs inte i del II. Kontrollera den aktuella uppladdningsstrukturen i CTIS före inlämning (EU-kommissionens Q&A placerar i regel översättningar i del II). Formulären ska vara begripliga och stämma överens med prövningsplanen.

fields.v105: Required in Finland: in Finnish and/or Swedish, state that every advertisement, invitation and other recruitment communication is submitted under Recruitment materials in Finnish and/or Swedish before use, that audio and video are submitted as a transcript (audio) or a transcript or storyboard (video), not as media files, and how responses are handled and people found unsuitable are informed (Tukija T/448/2026).
fields.v108: Required in Finland: in Finnish and/or Swedish, state that a qualified member of the investigating team gives the prior information, answers questions, allows enough decision time and verifies understanding; that the participant or legal representative and the person receiving consent sign and date the approved Finnish/Swedish form when consent is obtained (blank and unsigned in CTIS); that the original stays in the investigator's archive and a paper or electronic copy is given; that participants who speak neither Finnish nor Swedish receive all patient-facing documents in a language they understand, with an interpreter familiar with clinical trials, the participant's culture and the Finnish operating environment throughout the research unless the team speaks the language; and, for a cluster trial, that the Article 30 simplified consent route is not used in Finland.
fields.v110: Required in Finland when adults with reduced capacity are included: in Finnish and/or Swedish, describe the documented capacity assessment (diagnosis, disability or residence in care does not by itself prove incapacity); who consents under section 13 of the Clinical Trials Act 983/2021 (the legal representative; if there is none, a close family member or another person close to the participant) and how the site identifies that person and documents the relationship; the adapted participant information and any assent or acknowledgement; how verbal, behavioural or supported-communication dissent is recognised and respected; reassessment of capacity and the participant's own consent when capacity returns; and how a decision made before capacity was lost is evaluated under Article 31.
fields.v114: Required in Finland when minors are included: in Finnish and/or Swedish, describe the justified developmental groups and their documents (Tukija sets no fixed bands); guardian or other legal representative consent plus the written consent of a minor who can form an opinion and evaluate the information (section 14, Act 983/2021); the age-15 pathway, where an adolescent aged 15 to 17 consents independently only in an Article 32(1)(g)(i) direct-benefit trial and when able to understand its significance, with the guardian informed, including how understanding is assessed and how the guardian is notified; respect for a capable minor's refusal; and re-consent at 18 and on entering the age-15 pathway, as defined in the protocol.
fields.v117: Required in Finland when an impartial witness may be used: in Finnish and/or Swedish, state that the witness route applies only when the consenting participant or legal representative cannot write (not for another language, limited literacy or interpreter use alone); who checks the witness's independence and eligibility and what happens when no suitable witness is available; how the interpreter and witness roles are separated or, if one person does both, why; and that the witness and the person who conducted the discussion sign and date the consent record.
fields.v121: Required in Finland when emergency enrolment is used: in Finnish and/or Swedish, describe how the sudden serious condition, the therapeutic window, why the participant and the representative could not be informed in time, the direct-benefit basis, the check for a previously expressed objection and the time of the first intervention are recorded in the source; later consent without undue delay (representative for minors and adults with reduced capacity; otherwise participant or representative, whichever can decide sooner, and the participant's own consent once capable); the right to object to use of data already obtained; and staff instructions that separate trial documentation from urgent clinical care. No form may state retrospectively that consent was given before enrolment.

fields.f03: Finland, only when samples or related data will be used outside the protocol: state that future use is offered through a separate, optional Finnish and/or Swedish information sheet and consent form based on Tukija's future-use template (T/171/2025), independent of trial participation, and that refusal does not affect participation or treatment. Otherwise answer not applicable.

national_fields_note: Index of the national additions to shared forms; the same text is on each document (documents[].national_fields). Field ids are those of the shared <form>.fields.json. R1 needs no national sentence for Finland.

document_kinds.form: Regulatory form the assistant answers question by question. Keep the template layout and questions unchanged.
document_kinds.participant_document: Participant- or representative-facing document written section by section from a participant template, for one population.
document_kinds.third_party_template: Template completed by someone else (investigator). The assistant fills only trial fields (title, EU trial number) and leaves every other field empty for that person.
document_kinds.third_party_document: Document issued by someone else (insurer, sponsor finance or legal). Recorded as a source when received; only checked.
document_kinds.ctis_data: Information entered as structured data in CTIS; checked against the plan.

participant_templates.name_en: Subject Information and Assent Form - Adolescents
participant_templates.role: age-adapted information and written consent for adolescents under 15 (drafting band 12-14)
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be completed for studies involving adolescent participants (aged 12 - 17 years).

participant_templates.name_en: Subject Information and Consent Form - Adolescents
participant_templates.role: information and consent for adolescents 15-17: independent consent (section 14, Act 983/2021; Article 32(1)(g)(i)) with guardian notification, or own written consent alongside the guardian
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be completed for studies involving adolescent participants (aged 12 - 17 years).

participant_templates.name_en: Subject Information and Assent Form - Children
participant_templates.role: age-adapted information and written consent for children (drafting band 6-11)
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be completed for studies involving children participants (aged 6 - 11 years).

participant_templates.name_en: Emergency Enrolment and Deferred Consent Form
participant_templates.name_fi: Tiedote ja suostumus tutkimuksen jatkamiseen hätätilanteessa tapahtuneen mukaan ottamisen jälkeen
participant_templates.role: information and consent to continue after emergency enrolment (Article 35)
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be used when the study involves emergency enrolment before prior informed consent because neither the participant nor a legal representative can provide consent within the required treatment window.

participant_templates.name_en: Subject Information and Consent Form - Healthy Adults
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be completed for studies involving healthy adult participants (18 or older without a specific health condition). Can be used for non-treated participants when no other template applies.

participant_templates.name_en: Trial Information and Consent Form - Legal Representative
participant_templates.name_fi: Tutkittavan laillisesti nimetyn edustajan tiedote- ja suostumusasiakirja
participant_templates.role: information and consent for the legal representative (or close family member or other close person) of an adult with reduced capacity
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be used when the study involves adult participants who cannot provide informed consent and participation must be authorised by a legally authorised representative.

participant_templates.name_en: Subject Information and Assent Form - Limited Capacity
participant_templates.role: adapted information and expression of willingness for the adult with reduced capacity
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be used when the study involves an adult lacking consent capacity who retains sufficient understanding to receive adapted information and express assent, willingness or objection. It accompanies the legal representative’s consent.

participant_templates.name_en: Subject Information and Consent Form - Adult Patients
participant_templates.role: main information and consent (capable adult patients); also re-consent at 18 or when capacity returns
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be completed for studies involving adult patients (18 or older & diagnosed with a specific health condition). Can be used for patients when no other template applies such as re-consent after reaching adulthood, regained capacity, prescreening, or optional substudies or extension arms.

participant_templates.name_en: Trial Information and Consent Form - Parents
participant_templates.name_fi: Alaikäisen tutkittavan huoltajan tiedote- ja suostumusasiakirja

population_sets.basis: Tukija Participant Information Sheet and Informed Consent Form template T/447/2026 (25 June 2026); TrialAgents Finnish adult-patient template
population_sets.note: Retain Tukija's Pharmaceutical Injuries Insurance and patient-insurance wording unless the actual cover differs. Pregnancy follow-up of a participant who becomes pregnant may be covered here (see pregnancy_participant).

Mandatory whenever people without the condition under study are recruited; also useful as a separate document when a trial includes both patients and healthy volunteers. No therapeutic expectation; alternative is usually not to participate; payment reflects time and burden, not risk; withdrawal not financially punitive. No Finland-specific healthy-volunteer template replaces Tukija's general template.

Plan only the bands the protocol's age range needs; bands are justified in K1 (Tukija sets none). Guardian document whenever the guardian consents (all under-15s; 15-17 outside the independent pathway). Under the independent 15-17 pathway the guardian is informed, not asked to consent (population_rules.minors). Re-consent at 18 with the adult template.

Only after a documented assessment that the adult cannot understand enough to consent. Representative per section 13, Act 983/2021: legal representative; if none, a close family member or another close person. Article 31 conditions apply. Participant's own consent when capacity returns.

All Article 35 conditions. Later consent without undue delay; representative documents (legal-representative template) when the representative is available first; age-appropriate or adapted documents when minors or adults with reduced capacity can be enrolled. No form may state retrospectively that consent preceded enrolment.

Only when the consenting participant or legal representative cannot write. Not for another language, limited literacy or interpreter use alone; a witness cannot replace the legal representative. Finland publishes no separate witness form; Tukija's template is adapted.
Only when follow-up adds information, contacts, record access or duration the participant could not reasonably understand from the main consent; otherwise the main document covers it.

Mandatory when partner data are collected (Tukija template). The participant's consent does not authorise collection of the partner's data. Infant data after birth need their own legal basis and representative-consent pathway.

population_sets.basis: Tukija Information Sheet and Informed Consent Form for future use of biological samples and related data, T/171/2025 (18 November 2025)
population_sets.note: Mandatory when future sample use is requested, with S1 section 4 completed. Optional and independent of trial participation; no preselected checkbox. For data-only reuse the template may inform the structure but must not be presented as a national form (DECISIONS.md D14). Representative and re-consent rules apply for minors and adults with reduced capacity.

population_sets_note: population_sets list which templates a kind of population triggers; the actual populations are defined per study (playbook section 2a) and each population gets its own documents. documents = Finnish package (templates supplied); documents_sv = Swedish package (template "missing", no file path: adapt from the approved Finnish document).

population_rules.authority: Tukija (National Committee on Medical Research Ethics): Participant Information Sheet and Informed Consent Form template T/447/2026 (25 June 2026), national Part II requirements T/448/2026 (7 May 2026) and future-use template T/171/2025; Act on Clinical Trials on Medicinal Products 983/2021 sections 13 and 14; Regulation (EU) No 536/2014 Articles 28 to 35; as recorded in the Finland guides reviewed 23 September 2026.

language_sets.sv: missing: no Swedish participant templates supplied (participant_templates_missing); every population set lists its Swedish documents under documents_sv with template "missing".

minors.always_note: The guardian document is needed whenever the guardian or other legal representative consents: always under 15, and at 15-17 outside the independent pathway.
minors.band_rule: Tukija prescribes no fixed drafting bands (such as 6-11 and 12-17) and allows case-by-case groups such as pre-school children and adolescents. The supplied bands are drafting bands; choose those that reflect developmental understanding and the protocol and justify them in K1. The 15 threshold is statutory (section 14, Act 983/2021).

independent_consent_15_17.condition: Adolescent aged 15-17, able to understand the significance of the trial and procedure, in a trial within Article 32(1)(g)(i) (direct benefit expected to outweigh risks and burdens): study fact population.minors_independent_consent_15_17.
independent_consent_15_17.guardian: Informed of the participation, not asked to consent. The 15-17 template refers to the FINPEDMED FPM-E-005 notice or another approved procedure; no notification template supplied (DECISIONS.md D13). Describe the assessment of understanding and the guardian notification in K1.
independent_consent_15_17.not_automatic: Age 15 is not an automatic age of full consent: outside the exception the guardian consents and a capable adolescent also gives written consent.

minors.own_written_consent: A minor who can form an opinion and evaluate the information gives written consent in addition to the representative (section 14). A capable minor's refusal or wish to withdraw is respected at any time; guardian consent does not override it.
minors.under_6: No template. A very young child who cannot form an opinion may not need a signature form but still needs respectful, age-appropriate involvement; pre-school groups may be justified case by case (DECISIONS.md D12).
minors.content: Pregnancy and contraception content generally not in information for children under 12. Do not give a child an adult document with simplified headings only.
minors.reconsent_at_18: FI-PT-main-fi or FI-PT-healthy-fi before continuing after reaching 18; new consent may also be needed on entering the age-15 independent pathway, as defined in the protocol.
conflicts: The 12-14 and 15-17 template descriptions say 'aged 12 - 17 years'; the file names, model text and the statutory 15 threshold are followed (12-14 and 15-17).
minors.payment: No financial benefits or incentives for minors; only direct costs and loss of earnings (Finnish minors templates).

adults_without_capacity.note: Representative per section 13, Act 983/2021 (legal representative; if none, a close family member or other close person). Adapted participant information is required; the assent or acknowledgement part is used when the person can meaningfully express a view and the protocol uses written documentation. A capable refusal cannot be overridden. Participant's own consent (FI-PT-main-fi) when capacity returns.

emergency.note: Representative documents when the representative can decide first, and age-appropriate or adapted documents when minors or adults with reduced capacity can be enrolled; participant's own consent once capable.

impartial_witness.note: Only for a participant or legal representative who can decide but cannot write. The template description also mentions people who cannot read; the guide's narrower trigger (cannot write) wins. A representative who cannot write needs the witness block added to the representative document (DECISIONS.md D17).

pregnancy.participant: FI-PT-pregnancy-fi only when follow-up goes beyond what the main consent covers (the template description's 'must be used' is narrowed by the guide)
pregnancy.partner: FI-PT-pregnant-partner-fi whenever partner data are collected

secondary_use.note: Samples or sample-related data used outside the protocol. Data-only reuse: separate Article 28(2) choice; the template's description covers data too, but the guide forbids presenting it as a national form for a no-sample use case (DECISIONS.md D14).

separate_document_rules: Representatives get their own information and consent documents; changing the signature label on the participant document is not enough (Tukija).
Distinct groups recruited because of age or cognitive ability get their own documents (Tukija).
Future research outside the protocol must not be hidden inside the main consent: separate optional information and consent (Tukija T/171/2025).
A pregnant partner receives a separate information sheet and consent form before her data or records are collected.
Keep pregnancy follow-up consent separate from optional future research.
Re-consent after material changes: changes clearly identified in the revised documents, optionally with a summary of changes at the beginning.

drafting_rules: Participant documents: Tukija's template T/447/2026 (25 June 2026) is the drafting baseline (future use: T/171/2025), adapted to the protocol, population and Finnish operating environment; translated examples adapted to Finland.

Finnish and/or Swedish for recruitment advertising, the recruitment and consent procedure, information sheets and consent forms; the trial code and a concise, clear Finnish trial title identify each Finnish document.

Main information sheet about 5 to 8 pages, normally no more than 10; a longer document needs a real complexity justification. Detailed operating instructions go to a separate participant guide, but decision-relevant burdens and restrictions stay in the sheet.

Clear everyday language; define medical or foreign terms at first use; consistent units, time periods and form of address; no commands, inducements, promotional wording or wording that assumes agreement.

State that it is a clinical trial on medicinal products; trial name, code and EU trial number; why the person is invited; voluntariness and withdrawal without reason or loss of treatment rights near the start.
Do not promise benefit. Most severe and most common adverse reactions, comparator and procedure risks in the main sheet; separate standard care from trial-specific procedures and costs.
Ionising radiation: explain each examination, purpose, dose and risk; state when exposure is no greater than conventional care; frequency and total dose for several examinations.

GDPR Articles 12 to 14 information; legal bases cited by article, paragraph and point; balancing test when legitimate interest is used; pseudonymised data never called anonymous; 'ethnic background' instead of 'race' in Finnish text; Data Protection Ombudsman complaint route.

Retain Tukija's Finnish insurance explanation (Pharmaceutical Injuries Insurance vs the site's patient insurance) unless the actual cover differs; explain an alternative arrangement when the medicine is not covered.
Blank, unsigned, version-controlled documents in CTIS, as PDF or PDF/A; signature and date fields stay empty for the consent visit (participant or representative, and the person receiving consent).
Article 30 simplified cluster consent is not available in Finland.
Optional choices never preselected; withdrawal from future use distinguished from withdrawal from the trial.
Test drafts with lay readers and research staff; consult the patient group concerned; consider an easy-language version when the population needs it (recommended).
Swedish documents (no Swedish templates supplied): adapt from the approved Finnish document, keeping the same version; qualified translation; same structure and Finnish national content.

Participant templates (JSON): italic text, [square-bracket] notes and "..........." gaps are drafting instructions or gaps; follow and remove them. Part II templates (DOCX): yellow [INSERT/IF/OTHERWISE/CHOOSE/NOTE: ...] labels. Nothing of either may remain in a final document.

naming.convention: content/playbook/naming.md (CTCG Best Practice Guide: Naming of Documents in CTIS, v3.0, 10 February 2026)
naming.finland_note: Participant-facing and procedure documents carry _FI_fi or _FI_sv (ctis_titles per document). The Finland checklist page uses descriptive names (for example 'Trial financing and site payments', 'Biological-sample compliance statement'); the CTCG pattern is used instead. Finland splits compensation (P1, CTCG title) from financing (P2) and other agreements (P3). The invoicing details (CTIS Forms section) have no CTCG prefix (DECISIONS.md D11). Patient-facing forms follow Tukija's Part I placement (D4_...), with R2_... as the alternative if CTIS requires Part II (DECISIONS.md D7).
